conventions.C: 729 x 165 matrix, rows = boundary words on U in itertools.product((0,1,2), repeat=6) order, columns = itertools.combinations_with_replacement(range(9), 3) order
conventions.E: 6E = [3 s r^2 x + r^3] full-U-support component
conventions.cap_coordinates: K_ij, i = P-colour, j = Q-colour, k = 3i+j
conventions.pair_block_entries: a_ij = A_pq[i][j] (so s = sum a_ij K_ij)

relations.cross_word_rank_one: C[w][m] * C[w'][m'] - C[w][m'] * C[w'][m] = 0 (implied by the two above when v != 0)
relations.hard_zeros: C[w][m] = 0 for every word w and every m in hard_zero_monomials (degree 6 in the source entries)
relations.nondegeneracy: C != 0, else the pair is in case (c)
relations.proportionality: C[w][m] * v[m'] - C[w][m'] * v[m] = 0 for every word w and all m, m' in the support of v (degree 6+n_s)
